comments.author: Nadia Marin
comments.text: Delivered a model page with separate UUID-backed physical units. Model names can repeat; asset tags remain university-wide unique. Acceptance checked two cameras with the same display name and different tags.

description: Make the inventory work when we buy another camera of the same model.
label: area-cat
title: Separate equipment models from physical units

comments.author: Nadia Marin
comments.text: The Active filter is applied on first load. Staff can include Retired records without losing the selected lab and category filters.

description: Show Active units by default. Staff can explicitly include Retired units; keep lab and category filters combined with the lifecycle filter.
label: area-cat
title: Default the inventory screen to active units

comments.author: Vlad Petrescu
comments.text: The server now validates endAt later than startAt before conflict checking. The UI retains invalid values for correction instead of creating a reservation.

description: Some odd date selections are getting through the booking screen. Make them sensible.
label: area-rsv
title: Reject a booking whose end precedes its start

comments.author: Vlad Petrescu
comments.text: Booking details use the owning lab zone; the stored reservation timestamps remain UTC.

description: Persist reservation instants in UTC and render booking details using the owning lab IANA time zone. Verify the same UTC instant in Bucharest and London.
label: area-rsv
title: Use the lab time zone on booking details

comments.author: Sara Pavel
comments.text: The eligibility panel identifies the missing training category and directs the borrower to a training officer. It does not claim the lab manager can issue the certificate.

description: Students do not understand the training error. Improve it.
label: area-trn
title: Explain why a restricted tool cannot be borrowed

comments.author: Sara Pavel
comments.text: Suspension blocks both actions even when a matching training certificate is current.

description: A valid training certificate must not permit a suspended borrower to reserve or collect equipment. Test the valid-certificate plus suspended-account combination.
label: area-trn
title: Keep suspension checks alongside certificate checks

comments.author: Luca Dima
comments.text: Approval and rejection now append actor and request-version audit events. Reviewing a decided request shows the decision maker.

description: We need to know who decided a request after it leaves the inbox.
label: area-apr
title: Retain the manager decision in history

comments.author: Luca Dima
comments.text: The rejected request retains its reason. Its slot becomes available atomically with the state transition.

description: When a manager rejects an AwaitingApproval request with a reason, transition to Rejected and release its interval in the same transaction.
label: area-apr
title: Release a rejected approval hold

comments.author: Ana Stoica
comments.text: Labels encode only the opaque asset UUID. They contain no borrower ID, reservation secret, or authorization token.

description: Make the QR stickers safe to put on public equipment shelves.
label: area-out
title: Keep personal data out of printed equipment QR labels

comments.author: Ana Stoica
comments.text: The pickup checklist records present accessories and pre-existing exceptions as part of handover.

description: Staff must confirm required accessories before handover or record an existing exception. Show the checklist beside the borrower and asset tag.
label: area-out
title: Record pre-existing accessory exceptions at pickup

comments.author: Elena Varga
comments.text: Receipt records server receivedAt and puts the loan in ReturnedPendingInspection. A later condition inspection is a separate action; the unit remains unavailable in between.

description: The return desk needs to scan things in quickly and inspect them afterwards.
label: area-ret
title: Separate physical receipt from condition inspection

comments.author: Elena Varga
comments.text: Incomplete checklists are rejected and missing accessories route to an incident linked to the loan.

description: For each required accessory, require present or missing. Missing must open a linked incident and cannot produce a clean inspection result.
label: area-ret
title: Record a missing accessory during inspection

comments.author: Matei Ionescu
comments.text: The borrower sees the extension conflict reason without another borrower's identity. A rejected extension preserves dueAt.

description: The extension error leaks the next borrower. Clean it up.
label: area-ext
title: Explain extension failures without identifying another student

comments.author: Matei Ionescu
comments.text: Extension count is stored per loan; the ordinary action rejects a second approved extension on that loan.

description: Only one approved ordinary extension is allowed per loan. A different loan must not inherit the old loan's extension counter.
label: area-ext
title: Track the ordinary extension count on each loan

comments.author: Iris Popa
comments.text: Cancellation keeps the reservation row, cancellation actor, time, and reason. Cancelled intervals no longer block availability.

description: Cancelled bookings should not just disappear from our records.
label: area-can
title: Retain cancelled reservation history

comments.author: Iris Popa
comments.text: The borrower receives the recorded manager cancellation reason through the transaction notification.

description: A manager cancellation requires a borrower-visible reason. Include the same reason in the in-app notification after commitment.
label: area-can
title: Send the staff cancellation reason to the borrower inbox

comments.author: Nadia Marin
comments.text: A borrower can keep one active entry for the same model, lab, and requested interval. The API returns WAITLIST_DUPLICATE for the duplicate tuple.

description: People can join the same waiting list several times. Prevent that.
label: area-wai
title: Stop duplicate waiting-list entries

comments.author: Nadia Marin
comments.text: The offer owns a temporary availability hold. Only one of acceptance or expiry can commit.

description: An active waiting-list offer should temporarily block its assigned unit. Acceptance and expiry must use mutually exclusive transitions.
label: area-wai
title: Reserve an offered unit until offer resolution

comments.author: Vlad Petrescu
comments.text: Reservation details include pickupDeadlineAt in UTC and render the start and deadline in the owning lab time zone. This task did not choose or change the grace-period duration.

description: Students need to see when their pickup hold ends.
label: area-nos
title: Expose the pickup deadline on reservation details

comments.author: Vlad Petrescu
comments.text: The expiry event and reservation deadline remain distinct, making delayed worker runs visible without altering the schedule.

description: When expiry runs late, retain the scheduled deadline and record actual processing time separately. Do not move the displayed deadline to worker execution time.
label: area-nos
title: Separate worker run time from scheduled pickup deadline

comments.author: Sara Pavel
comments.text: Overdue duration is derived from dueAt and receipt or current server time rather than accumulated worker increments.

description: The overdue counter drifts when the worker misses a run. Make it reliable.
label: area-ovd
title: Compute overdue hours from loan timestamps

comments.author: Sara Pavel
comments.text: The restriction service exposes separate reasons and derives overdue restriction state from current loans.

description: Return distinct machine reasons for overdue_loan and manual_suspension. Do not represent all restrictions as one permanent account boolean.
label: area-ovd
title: Separate automatic and manual restriction reasons

comments.author: Luca Dima
comments.text: New incident reports require asset, loan, reporting actor, observation time, type, and observation text.

description: We cannot tell which loan a damage note belongs to. Fix incident traceability.
label: area-dam
title: Link incident reports to the affected borrowing record

comments.author: Luca Dima
comments.text: Private photograph access requires a matching incident_reader grant rather than general borrower or audit access.

description: Check incident_reader for the incident's owning lab on every photo request. Return private authorized links only after this check.
label: area-dam
title: Guard private incident photograph downloads

comments.author: Ana Stoica
comments.text: Supplier repairs remain InProgress until staff record the service outcome. The maintenance block stays in force.

description: A repair should not look completed just because we shipped it to a supplier.
label: area-mnt
title: Show repair progress while a supplier has the unit

comments.author: Ana Stoica
comments.text: The completed job includes the checklist results, outcome, attesting technician, and authoritative completion instant.

description: Service completion must record the required checklist, outcome, and technician attestation, with server completedAt.
label: area-mnt
title: Record technician and service outcome at completion

comments.author: Elena Varga
comments.text: Transfers have separate custody events and do not create a borrower loan or overdue borrower record.

description: Moving an asset on the university van should not create an overdue student loan.
label: area-xfr
title: Keep transfer custody separate from student borrowing

comments.author: Elena Varga
comments.text: Dispatch checks outstanding borrowing and returns 409 ASSET_ON_LOAN without changing custody.

description: Reject transfer dispatch if the asset has an Open loan. Return ASSET_ON_LOAN without recording dispatch.
label: area-xfr
title: Prevent dispatching equipment still on loan

comments.author: Matei Ionescu
comments.text: The kit definition references component asset UUIDs. Kit membership neither merges identities nor replaces physical unit records.

description: Bundle the field recorder equipment without losing track of the individual serialled units.
label: area-kit
title: Keep physical unit identities inside kits

comments.author: Matei Ionescu
comments.text: The kit handover screen validates each tracked component scan before checkout can commit.

description: Checkout must scan every required tracked component and reject a missing or wrong unit with KIT_SCAN_INCOMPLETE.
label: area-kit
title: Require scans for each tracked kit component

comments.author: Iris Popa
comments.text: Intent uniqueness uses domain event ID, recipient ID, and channel. Redelivering one outbox event does not create a second identical intent.

description: Worker redelivery sends multiple copies of one change. Make notification creation safe.
label: area-ntf
title: Deduplicate notification intents after worker retries

comments.author: Iris Popa
comments.text: Read receipts change inbox state only and never perform offer acceptance.

description: Marking a waiting-list notification read must not create a reservation. Only the explicit offer acceptance action may do so.
label: area-ntf
title: Do not accept offers when their messages are read

comments.author: Nadia Marin
comments.text: The lab selector changes interface context only. All protected data still requires server authorization from stored grants.

description: Changing the header lab should not let students open staff screens.
label: area-sec
title: Keep selected lab separate from permission grants

comments.author: Nadia Marin
comments.text: Mutation audit attribution uses the session actor even when a malicious request supplies another actorId.

description: Derive mutation actorId exclusively from the authenticated session. A request body field cannot impersonate a different staff member.
label: area-sec
title: Ignore actor IDs supplied by API clients

comments.author: Vlad Petrescu
comments.text: Corrections generate new audit events. No API can rewrite an existing event body, and writer permissions enforce append-only storage.

description: An edited record needs to leave its previous history intact.
label: area-aud
title: Make sensitive-action history append only

comments.author: Vlad Petrescu
comments.text: Operational summaries contain aggregate counts only; the cleanup job does not create a second copy of removed events.

description: Each retention run should retain aggregate deletion counts but must not copy deleted event bodies into its own run log.
label: area-aud
title: Summarize audit cleanup without duplicating deleted records

comments.author: Sara Pavel
comments.text: Integration events come from the transactional outbox after their domain transaction commits.

description: The scheduler sometimes sees a booking event for a booking that never committed. Fix publication ordering.
label: area-int
title: Publish integration events only after commitment

comments.author: Sara Pavel
comments.text: Credential revocation affects the next request; it does not depend on worker or API process restarts.

description: A revoked service credential must fail subsequent API requests without an application restart. Verify another active credential remains usable.
label: area-int
title: Stop revoked service credentials immediately

comments.author: Luca Dima
comments.text: The footer shows lab, local date range, generatedAt, and row-limit status. The job stores normalized UTC bounds and input time zone.

description: Managers cannot tell what period a downloaded report covers. Include its context.
label: area-rpt
title: Show report provenance in the footer

comments.author: Luca Dima
comments.text: Download checks both requester identity and current grants; revoking access blocks a previously generated result.

description: A completed export can be downloaded only by its original requester while they still hold manager grants for the exported labs.
label: area-rpt
title: Recheck access before an export download
